answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 1960 Country: SG Title: Can someone marry his father-in-law's second wife (step mother-in-law)? Question: Can someone marry his father-in-law's second wife (step mother-in-law)? Answer ID: 1960 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 631/623/M) Yes, one can marry the second wife of his father-in-law i.e. his step mother-in-law. لقولہ تعالی: و احل لکم ما وراء ذلکم (الآیۃ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
